newsitem.title: UK: Octavian hopes for talks on Lloyd's syndicate 866.
newsitem.headline: Octavian hopes for talks on Lloyd's syndicate 866.

text.p: Octavian Syndicate Management Limited said on Friday it would like to acquire the management rights of Lloyd's of London Syndicate 866 from Archer Group Holdings.

"We're planning to start a new syndicate, but ideally what we'd like to do if it is possible is to acquire the right to manage Syndicate 866 from Archer," Octavian managing director Nigel Rogers told Reuters.

Octavian said yesterday that Syndicate 866 underwriter Peter Routledge was leaving Archer to set up a new motor insurance syndicate at Octavian, which is part of Bermuda based insurance company Terra Nova.

"We haven't had a chance to sit down and talk about it, but the impression I've got from speaking to most of the capital providers to the syndicate is that they would quite like the syndicate and underwriting team to stay together," Rogers said.
"I hope Archer will give us a chance to have those discussions," he added

Bryan Kellett, chairman of the Archer Group, said, "We are very carefully analysing the options which are open to us and pursuing them to see what is the best way forward...We are devising our strategy for the future."

The recent departure of another Archer underwriter, David Lowe, was coincidental, Kellett said, adding that there was no problem at the group, which operates one of the largest managing agencies within the Lloyd's market.
Rogers said Octavian plans to expand its motor insurance operations, which currently consist of Abbey motor Syndicate 554 with annual premium capacity of 17 million stg.

"We want a greater involvement in motor. In a soft market you can't do that by organic growth. You need to make acquisitions. The motor market is just now, we believe, seeing the first signs of the upturn and we want to lay the foundations for what we think will be a market which strengthens over the next few years," he said.
Parent company Terra Nova was prepared to provide at least 50 million stg to support a new syndicate, Rogers said.
Archer Syndicate 866 has 1996 premium capacity of 96 million stg.
